# has prompt

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasPrompt`](gmeow-hasPrompt.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasPrompt>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A prompt presented in this invocation. Non-functional: a chat invocation carries several prompts in conversational roles ([`gmeow:promptRole`](gmeow-promptRole.md)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) -> [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasPrompt`](gmeow-hasPrompt.md) from [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) to [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) to each [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) presented in it — assert several, in their conversational roles, for a multi-turn chat invocation.

### Avoid when

- Avoid flattening prompt text onto the invocation (mint a [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) so it is content-addressable and role-tagged) and avoid treating it as functional — a chat carries system, user, and tool prompts together.

### How to use

- Point the [`ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) at one or more [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) individuals, each carrying [`gmeow:promptRole`](gmeow-promptRole.md) and [`gmeow:contentDigest`](gmeow-contentDigest.md); a contested or templated prompt links to its [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](../classes/gmeow-PromptTemplate.md) via [`gmeow:filledFrom`](gmeow-filledFrom.md).
